case_240:
rounded_soft is present (smooth rounded contours, gently reinforced focal features) but deep_jewel is absent: blouse is flat black and skirt neutral grey across all 3 seeds (dark-region RGB ~44/39/39 and ~35/34/36, no chromatic hue), and fine_tonal_hatching survives only as faint skirt texture: real defect on coloring. -- overturned at full resolution: case_240 = style_id linework_coloring_rounded_soft_deep_jewel_fine_tonal_hatching_reflected_color_complete_line_color -> test_ids P7000718 (seed 1001), P7000719 (2002), P7000720 (3003), all 1024x1024. Both halves of the hold reasoning fail at full resolution.

(1) "deep_jewel absent / no chromatic hue in dark regions" is a thumbnail artifact. Segmenting garment mid-tones (V 14-110, excluding ink lines and skin) in the lower half gives a coherent, seed-specific jewel hue in each render, not neutral grey: P7000720 has 59% chromatic garment pixels with hue tightly clustered at 210-270 deg (deep sapphire / ink navy; blouse mean RGB 23.3/24.1/27.0, i.e. B > R by ~4 levels, plainly visible as blue-black at 1:1 and unmistakable under a 3x brightness/saturation boost); P7000718 has 38% chromatic pixels clustered at 0-60 deg with a warm/cool split - cool indigo blouse (22.5/21.2/22.9) against a warm garnet-brown skirt (57.6/51.7/48.8, R-B +8.9); P7000719 is the weakest (18% chromatic, warm plus violet/magenta). The reviewer's RGB samples were roughly accurate, but the inference was wrong: the catalog text for this item is "deep jewel color separated by dark neutrals and small high-value accents", so dark neutral separation is specified behaviour, and low absolute chroma here tracks the reflected_color light factor rather than a coloring failure.

Palette-group calibration confirms this. saturation_screen.json (group_axis coloring, deviation 0.5) reports deep_jewel: 43 items, median 0.1628, min 0.1107, max 0.2117, outlier_count 0 - no deep_jewel item is flagged, including this one. Recomputing per-item mean HSV saturation across all 43 deep_jewel items ranks this item 12th of 43 at 0.1285, above the group minimum, and every one of the ~15 reflected_color siblings sits in the same 0.11-0.17 band while the controlled_rim siblings sit at 0.16-0.21. The nearest neighbours differing only in light (P7000715, rounded_soft_deep_jewel_fine_tonal_hatching_controlled_rim, 0.1958) and only in shading (P7000712, rounded_soft_deep_jewel_crisp_shape_shadow_reflected_color, 0.1132 - the group minimum) render the same dark blouse plus grey skirt wardrobe, so the near-black garment reading is a rig-wide property of deep_jewel under this subject anchor, not a defect specific to case_240.

(2) "fine_tonal_hatching survives only as faint skirt texture" is flatly contradicted at full resolution. At 2x on the torso crop of P7000718 the skirt, waistband, and sleeve/hem folds carry dense parallel fine hatch strokes, and P7000719 shows fine hatching on both sleeves, the chest folds, the waistband, and the skirt - exactly the specified "concentrated in occluded folds and kept sparse across skin". P7000720 is the weakest hatching seed (folds resolved mostly as planar dark shapes with hatch-like parallel bands at hem and cuffs), but it is also the seed with the strongest jewel hue, so no seed is missing both factors. rounded_soft is present in all three, as the reviewer already granted.

Residual caveat: chroma is genuinely low in absolute terms and seed 2002 is the marginal one; nothing here is a saturated emerald/ruby. But the defect as written - deep_jewel absent, hatching reduced to faint skirt texture - does not survive full-resolution inspection, and the item is in-band for its own palette group.
